tagline: An estrogen-responsive E. coli biosensor coupled to secreted bacterial laccase, immobilised in PVA-alginate beads as a contained tank inside an existing wastewater treatment train
tagline_zh: 一種對雌激素有反應的 E. coli 生物感測器，與分泌型細菌漆酶串接，固定在 PVA-海藻酸鹽珠體中，作為既有污水處理流程內的一座封閉式槽體
summary: FINS detects and degrades estrogenic endocrine disruptors (estrone E1, 17beta-estradiol E2, 17alpha-ethinylestradiol EE2) in wastewater. Module 1 uses EdcR, a TetR-family estrogen-dependent repressor from Caenibius tardaugens, expressed constitutively from BBa_J23105 to hold the Pb promoter shut; estrogen de-represses Pb, a T7 RNA polymerase stage amplifies the partial de-repression, and the output is either mScarlet3 (detection build) or secreted 6xHis-tagged BPul laccase from Bacillus pumilus, which oligomerises estrogens by oxidative coupling in the bulk phase. Module 2 is a holin-endolysin kill switch whose trigger was rebuilt from UV/LexA-SOS to RclR with the rclA promoter after wastewater practitioners pointed out Indian plants disinfect with sodium hypochlorite, not UV, on cost grounds. The project is sited as a discrete tank after secondary treatment and before chlorination, so the plant's own disinfection stage doubles as containment. The dry lab is the standout: 13 coupled ODEs, exact Gillespie and Linear Noise Approximation cross-checks, Fisher information and a Cramer-Rao limit of detection, a lattice-Boltzmann packed-bed solve, and a bespoke C++ elastic network solver released as open software.
summary_zh: FINS 偵測並降解廢水中的雌激素類內分泌干擾物（雌酮 E1、17beta-雌二醇 E2、17alpha-炔雌醇 EE2）。模組 1 使用 EdcR，一個來自 Caenibius tardaugens 的 TetR 家族雌激素依賴型抑制蛋白，由 BBa_J23105 組成型表現，使 Pb 啟動子保持關閉；雌激素會解除對 Pb 的抑制，再由一段 T7 RNA 聚合酶放大這部分去抑制，輸出則是 mScarlet3（偵測版本）或分泌型、帶 6xHis 標籤的 Bacillus pumilus BPul 漆酶，後者在液相中以氧化偶合把雌激素寡聚化。模組 2 是一個 holin-endolysin 自殺開關；在污水處理從業者指出印度的處理廠出於成本考量是以次氯酸鈉而非 UV 消毒之後，其觸發機制從 UV/LexA-SOS 改建為搭配 rclA 啟動子的 RclR。整套系統被設置為二級處理之後、加氯之前的一座獨立槽體，因此處理廠自身的消毒步驟同時兼作生物圍阻。乾實驗是最突出的部分：13 條耦合 ODE、精確 Gillespie 與線性雜訊近似的交互驗證、Fisher 資訊量與 Cramer-Rao 偵測極限、一次格子 Boltzmann 填充床求解，以及一套自行開發、以開源軟體釋出的 C++ 彈性網路求解器。

dry.frameworks: A ten-page modelling stack, each page ending in numbers and an explicit uncertainty page that re-derives the uncertainty of the other nine using school-level arithmetic. Deterministic core: 27 mass-action reactions reduced to 13 ODEs under three stated assumptions (well-mixed 1 fL cell so Omega = 0.602192 molecules per nM; mRNA at quasi-steady state since delta_m = 0.231 >> delta_p = 0.0261; one dilution rate for all proteins). Hill repression at the operator fitted directly by least squares in SciPy against digitised fluorescence from Ibero et al. Figure 12, giving K_eff and n = 1.49; the team flags that the repression coefficient was tuned to reproduce the measured leak and is therefore 'an input wearing a prediction's clothes', while every other number is a prediction. A pure elongation calculation from actual construct lengths, with transcription and translation overlapping in E. coli, gives 1.158 min to synthesise and 38.158 min to first photon. Transport: a diffusion-based molecular communication model (built on Adam Noel's framework but for a sustained source rather than a pulse) carrying estrogen from the well through medium, across membrane, to the repressor, justified by measured octanol-water partition coefficients satisfying Overton's rule, with a three-layer cell and conservative-solver mass-balance closure to machine precision. Reactor: a lattice-Boltzmann solve (D3Q19, TRT) of the packed bead bed reproducing porosity to 0.04% and Kozeny-Carman permeability to 0.998x, validated against Zick and Homsy within 2.4%, feeding a geometric depth-removal argument. Structural: AlphaFold 2 (32 models across three runs) on wild-type EdcR, docking of E1 and EE2 to BPul laccase and to the EdcR dimer, plus two independent 100 ns GROMACS MD runs (amber99sb-ildn, TIP3P, GAFF2/AM1-BCC ligand, ~80,300 atoms, 4 fs with hydrogen mass repartitioning).
dry.frameworks_zh: 一套十頁的建模堆疊，每一頁都以數字收尾，另有一頁明確的不確定性分析，用中學程度的算術重新推導其餘九頁的不確定性。決定論核心：27 條質量作用反應在三項明示假設下化簡為 13 條 ODE（均勻混合的 1 fL 細胞，因此 Omega = 0.602192 分子每 nM；mRNA 處於準穩態，因為 delta_m = 0.231 >> delta_p = 0.0261；所有蛋白質採用同一個稀釋率）。操作子處的 Hill 抑制以 SciPy 的最小平方法，直接對 Ibero 等人 Figure 12 中數位化擷取的螢光資料擬合，得到 K_eff 與 n = 1.49；團隊並標示抑制係數是為了重現實測的滲漏而調校出來的，因此是一個穿著預測外衣的輸入值，而其餘每一個數字都是預測。一項純粹的延伸速率計算，依實際構築體長度並考慮 E. coli 中轉錄與轉譯重疊，得到合成需 1.158 分鐘、到第一個光子需 38.158 分鐘。傳輸：一個以擴散為基礎的分子通訊模型（建立在 Adam Noel 的框架上，但針對持續性來源而非脈衝），把雌激素從水體經介質、穿過細胞膜一路帶到抑制蛋白，依據是實測的辛醇-水分配係數符合 Overton 規則，並採用三層細胞模型與守恆型求解器，使質量平衡閉合到機器精度。反應器：一次格子 Boltzmann 求解（D3Q19、TRT）模擬填充珠床，孔隙率重現誤差 0.04%、Kozeny-Carman 滲透率重現至 0.998 倍，並與 Zick 及 Homsy 的結果相符至 2.4% 以內，再餵入一個幾何式的深度去除率論證。結構：對野生型 EdcR 做 AlphaFold 2（三次執行共 32 個模型）、把 E1 與 EE2 分子嵌合到 BPul 漆酶與 EdcR 二聚體上，另有兩次獨立的 100 ns GROMACS 分子動力學模擬（amber99sb-ildn、TIP3P、GAFF2/AM1-BCC 配體、約 80,300 個原子、採氫質量重分配的 4 fs 步長）。
dry.dataviz: Figures carry their own epistemic status. Dose-response panels overlay the digitised source bars, the Hill fit as a dashed line and the integrated ODE steady state as a solid line, with the unrepressed control marked. Gillespie histograms are drawn under LNA curves for each of the three core species across the estrone sweep. The stochastic dose-response plots single Gillespie cells as dots, their mean with 1 SD bars as circles, and the ODE steady state as a line, on both linear and log axes. Fisher information is plotted per cell against estrone for four constitutive promoter strengths. A dedicated dry-vs-wet figure and a knob-ranges figure put model predictions against what the bench actually produced. An interactive browser Normal Mode Explorer renders modes as per-residue displacement arrows coloured blue to red on the structure, overlays CCP4/MRC density as contour mesh or solid isosurface, and reports cross-correlation before and after flexible fitting.
dry.dataviz_zh: 圖表各自帶著自己的知識論地位。劑量反應圖組疊上數位化擷取的原始長條、以虛線呈現的 Hill 擬合，以及以實線呈現的 ODE 穩態值，並標出未受抑制的對照。Gillespie 直方圖畫在 LNA 曲線之下，涵蓋雌酮掃描中三個核心物種各自的情形。隨機版的劑量反應圖以點表示單一 Gillespie 細胞、以帶 1 個標準差誤差棒的圓圈表示其平均值、以線表示 ODE 穩態，並同時以線性與對數座標呈現。Fisher 資訊量則以每個細胞為單位對雌酮作圖，涵蓋四種組成型啟動子強度。另有一張專門的乾實驗對濕實驗圖與一張參數可調範圍圖，把模型預測與實驗桌上實際做出的結果擺在一起。可互動的瀏覽器版 Normal Mode Explorer 會把模態以每個殘基的位移箭頭、由藍到紅上色疊在結構上，可把 CCP4/MRC 密度以等值線網格或實體等值面疊加，並報告柔性擬合前後的交叉相關係數。
dry.datascience: The information-theoretic treatment is the strongest in this cohort. One LNA solve per estrone level gives mean and variance of each species; derivatives are taken by central differences with h = 0.01*theta (closed form 6.2560 vs finite difference 6.2559 for the reporter at 322.5 ng/mL). ODE, LNA and exact Gillespie (1,500 cells per level) agree to within 0.17% and 0.49% on means, with the largest gap (T7 at 409 ng/mL, +1.8%) attributed to gate curvature the LNA omits. From Fisher information they derive a Cramer-Rao bound and a limit of detection of 54.5 ng/mL at N = 10^3 cells, and show analytically that only K_E1, the noise CV/gain of the molecule read, and N enter the LOD formula (matching the full LNA to 0.5%). A systematic knob sweep raising each parameter up to x1000 with the full 9-species LNA shows amplification scales signal and noise together so SNR is unchanged: three orders of amplification move the LOD by 1.9 ng/mL while three orders of k3 move it by 53. They explicitly retire the Fano factor as a figure of merit here ('a low value means a brighter circuit, not a quieter one'), identify a tighter estrone-binding protein as the only real lever, note LOD scales as N^(-1/4), and then conclude against themselves: surface water and effluent hold under 0.01 ng/mL, over three orders of magnitude below their LOD. Elasticity analysis identifies the Hill coefficient as the largest elasticity (-0.613 on the width of the working window, an order of magnitude above the next constant) and the quantity the wet lab most clearly contradicts. The working window where fluorescence actually encodes concentration is bounded at 147 to 988 ng/mL, a 6.70x span, taken as 10% and 90% of the climb from G_off to G_on. Reactor sizing is translated into plant terms: 95 m2 cross-section for one 57 MLD sewage plant, 889 m2 for all of Kolkata's 534 MLD, and a 3400x bead penalty for treating a 17 m3/day factory stream downstream at the city plant instead of at source.
dry.datascience_zh: 資訊論的處理是這一批團隊中最強的。每個雌酮濃度各做一次 LNA 求解，得到各物種的平均值與變異數；導數以中央差分取得，h = 0.01*theta（在 322.5 ng/mL 處，報告蛋白的閉合解為 6.2560、有限差分為 6.2559）。ODE、LNA 與精確 Gillespie（每個濃度 1,500 個細胞）在平均值上相符至 0.17% 與 0.49% 以內，最大落差（409 ng/mL 處的 T7，+1.8%）被歸因於 LNA 未納入的閘門曲率。他們由 Fisher 資訊量推導出 Cramer-Rao 下界，並在 N = 10^3 個細胞下得到 54.5 ng/mL 的偵測極限，再以解析方式證明只有 K_E1、分子讀取的雜訊變異係數對增益之比，以及 N 會進入 LOD 公式（與完整 LNA 相符至 0.5%）。一次系統性的參數掃描把每個參數分別提高至 1000 倍，並以完整的 9 物種 LNA 計算，顯示放大會讓訊號與雜訊同步放大，因此訊雜比不變：三個數量級的放大只讓 LOD 移動 1.9 ng/mL，而三個數量級的 k3 卻能移動 53。他們明確在此處廢除 Fano 因子作為評價指標（「數值低代表迴路更亮，而不是更安靜」），指出唯一真正的槓桿是找到一個對雌酮結合更緊的蛋白，注意到 LOD 隨 N^(-1/4) 縮放，然後做出不利於自己的結論：地表水與放流水的濃度低於 0.01 ng/mL，比他們的 LOD 低超過三個數量級。彈性分析指出 Hill 係數具有最大的彈性（對工作窗寬度為 -0.613，比次高的常數高出一個數量級），而這正是濕實驗最明確牴觸的量。螢光真正能編碼濃度的工作窗落在 147 至 988 ng/mL，跨距 6.70 倍，取法是從 G_off 爬升到 G_on 的 10% 與 90%。反應器尺寸被換算成處理廠的語言：一座 57 MLD 污水廠需要 95 m2 的截面積，整個加爾各答的 534 MLD 則需要 889 m2，而把一股 17 m3/day 的工廠廢水放到下游的市級處理廠處理而非在源頭處理，珠體用量會付出 3400 倍的代價。
dry.software: Quiver, at gitlab.igem.org/2026/software/iiser-kolkata/quiver: a compiled elastic network model solver (enm-solve, ANM and GNM) with a dependency-free browser viewer, the Normal Mode Explorer, and a 27-page PDF handbook. It takes PDB/mmCIF, optionally an AlphaFold predicted aligned error matrix, or a multi-model conformational ensemble or MD trajectory; it outputs mode files and per-residue fluctuation profiles in native formats for VMD, ProDy, PyMOL, ChimeraX, NumPy and MATLAB. The viewer does normal-mode display, cryo-EM density display, normal-mode flexible fitting of a structure into a map, and an AlphaFold-informed dynamics and essential-dynamics workspace. Validation is the remarkable part. (1) A 206-structure crystallographic B-factor benchmark, median Pearson r = 0.633, reported on a single-chain protocol with the 75 multi-chain files flagged as making that a lower bound, and the selection queries, rejected entries with reasons and download commands committed to the repo. (2) Independent cross-check: five structures re-run end to end through ProDy's own parser, Kirchhoff matrix and fluctuations, agreeing to within 0.01 (1UBQ 0.806 vs 0.804, 2LZM 0.578 vs 0.576, 7RSA 0.628 vs 0.628, 1GPB 0.400 vs 0.399, 1HRC 0.192 vs 0.19). (3) MD validation against the two 100 ns trajectories, with the XTC decoder itself verified frame-0 atom-by-atom against the deposited start.pdb before any analysis, because a subtly wrong decoder produces plausible numbers. Amplitude correlation 0.824-0.840 against simulated RMSF over 388 residues, apo and holo agreeing to within 0.016. Cutoff robustness: ANM varies by at most 0.05 between 10 and 18 A and peaks at the 15 A default taken from literature and not fitted, while GNM's 10 A default is shown to be suboptimal here by about 0.06. Directional validation by RMSIP against essential dynamics: 0.715 at k = 10 against a random expectation of 0.092 confirmed over 200 random orthonormal subspace pairs, specific to the input structure (each network matches its own trajectory at 0.715 and the other at 0.51-0.55) and, strikingly, the two MD trajectories agree with each other at only 0.598, so the elastic model predicts each trajectory better than the other trajectory does. Three of 1,164 coordinates carry half the motion. Rigid-body sanity: exactly six zero modes at 20,000 residues with overlap 1.000000 against the analytic basis. 33 tests, a pinned Docker image, Linux/macOS Intel and Apple Silicon/Windows via WSL2, an explicitly stated domain of applicability (compact globular protein-only structures), and a stated requirement that release builds disable fused multiply-add contraction or the sparse-vs-dense Hessian consistency check fails on arm64.
dry.software_zh: Quiver，位於 gitlab.igem.org/2026/software/iiser-kolkata/quiver：一個編譯型的彈性網路模型求解器（enm-solve，含 ANM 與 GNM），搭配一個零相依的瀏覽器檢視器 Normal Mode Explorer，以及一本 27 頁的 PDF 手冊。它可接受 PDB/mmCIF，選擇性地接受 AlphaFold 的預測對齊誤差矩陣，或是多模型構型系集與分子動力學軌跡；輸出則是模態檔與每個殘基的擾動分布，格式可直接供 VMD、ProDy、PyMOL、ChimeraX、NumPy 與 MATLAB 使用。檢視器能做正規模態顯示、冷凍電顯密度顯示、把結構以正規模態柔性擬合進密度圖，並提供一個由 AlphaFold 資訊輔助的動力學與本質動力學工作區。真正了不起的是驗證。（1）一項涵蓋 206 個結構的晶體 B 因子基準測試，Pearson r 中位數為 0.633，以單鏈流程報告，並標示其中 75 個多鏈檔案使這個數字只是下界；篩選查詢語句、被排除的條目與排除理由，以及下載指令都提交到 repository 中。（2）獨立交叉驗證：五個結構完整重跑一次，改用 ProDy 自己的解析器、Kirchhoff 矩陣與擾動計算，結果相符至 0.01 以內（1UBQ 0.806 對 0.804，2LZM 0.578 對 0.576，7RSA 0.628 對 0.628，1GPB 0.400 對 0.399，1HRC 0.192 對 0.19）。（3）對兩條 100 ns 軌跡的分子動力學驗證，而且在做任何分析之前，先把 XTC 解碼器本身以第 0 幀逐原子對照已存放的 start.pdb 驗證過，因為一個只錯得很細微的解碼器會產生看起來合理的數字。在 388 個殘基上，振幅與模擬 RMSF 的相關係數為 0.824-0.840，apo 與 holo 兩種形式相符至 0.016 以內。截斷半徑的穩健性：ANM 在 10 至 18 A 之間變動至多 0.05，並在取自文獻、未經擬合的 15 A 預設值處達到峰值；GNM 的 10 A 預設值則被證明在此並非最佳，差距約 0.06。方向性驗證以 RMSIP 對本質動力學進行：在 k = 10 時為 0.715，相對於隨機期望值 0.092，後者以 200 對隨機正交子空間確認；這個結果對輸入結構具專一性（每個網路對上自己的軌跡為 0.715，對上另一條則為 0.51-0.55）；更引人注目的是，兩條分子動力學軌跡彼此之間只相符至 0.598，因此彈性模型對每條軌跡的預測比另一條軌跡還準。1,164 個座標中有 3 個承載了一半的運動。剛體檢核：在 20,000 個殘基下恰好得到六個零模態，與解析基底的重疊度為 1.000000。另有 33 項測試、一個版本鎖定的 Docker 映像、支援 Linux/macOS 的 Intel 與 Apple Silicon 以及透過 WSL2 的 Windows、一段明確寫出的適用範圍（僅限緊緻的球狀純蛋白質結構），以及一項明述要求：正式版建置必須關閉融合乘加的運算合併，否則在 arm64 上稀疏與稠密 Hessian 矩陣的一致性檢查會失敗。
techniques: Deterministic ODE circuit modelling with stated reduction assumptions
Hill-function parameter fitting by least squares on digitised literature data
Analytic limit-of-detection derivation and knob sweeps
Essential dynamics / PCA of MD trajectories
RMSIP subspace overlap with randomised null
Normal-mode flexible fitting into cryo-EM density
Reactor sizing and process-train siting calculations

good.publicEngagement: Between June and September 2026 the team ran a structured science-education programme reaching about 1,000 students aged 8 to 18 across four schools and their own institute, pitched separately for each age band from class 3 to class 12 and deliberately extended to students who are rarely asked. Teaching was mostly in Bengali, keeping the English terms and building explanations around them, because synthetic biology's vocabulary (plasmid, promoter, transcription, chassis) has no settled Bengali equivalents. Rani Rashmoni School (24 June, class 3-4): living versus non-living through a card game, then cells, DNA and a live DNA extraction. Satish Chandra Memorial School (8 July, class 11-12): genetic engineering, CRISPR and synthetic biology as a discipline; the team found this audience knew more of the content than expected and less of the practice than assumed, so the useful addition was not information but the fact that a person sits down and designs recombinant DNA. Bharat Sevashram Sangha (8 July, class 10), a residential school for Scheduled Tribe students: the prepared class 10 session had to be rebuilt from the base vocabulary mid-session, and the team names the lesson plainly, that prior exposure and not age sets the starting point, and that they had not noticed the age assumption because it had held everywhere else. Institute Open Day (10 July) ran FINS itself as the exhibit, including the parts that did not work, delivered forty to fifty times in short bursts to mixed class 9-12 groups; it was covered by DD Bangla, the state public broadcaster, carrying the project to a general Bengali-speaking audience. A week-long institute summer camp for about 70 students from North-Eastern India, organised with Kendriya Vidyalaya, included lab tours, the modelling side of the project and an original synthetic-biology crime-scene investigation. A long-term partnership with Ek Pehal runs Saturday on-campus sessions and Sunday neighbourhood visits for children from settlements around IISER Kolkata, for which the team wrote 41 free teaching files in English, Hindi and Bengali for classes 8-12 plus 36 literacy/numeracy/science files for younger children. A free webinar on Master's and PhD study abroad drew 151 registrants with Dr Deepak Kumar Malik (President, DAAD IndiAlumni) and the Emerging Scholars Council. Education props were built from cardboard, paper and reused items, which the team notes as an unplanned consequence worth keeping: materials that cost nothing to make are materials a school with no science budget can remake exactly.
good.publicEngagement_zh: 2026 年 6 月至 9 月間，團隊執行了一項有結構的科學教育計畫，在四所學校與自己的研究院觸及約 1,000 名 8 至 18 歲學生，從三年級到十二年級各年齡層分別設計內容，並刻意延伸到那些很少被問到的學生。授課多以孟加拉語進行，保留英文術語並圍繞它們建立說明，因為合成生物學的詞彙（plasmid、promoter、transcription、chassis）在孟加拉語中尚無定譯。Rani Rashmoni School（6 月 24 日，三至四年級）：先用卡牌遊戲區分生物與非生物，再談細胞、DNA，並現場做 DNA 萃取。Satish Chandra Memorial School（7 月 8 日，十一至十二年級）：基因工程、CRISPR 與作為一門學科的合成生物學；團隊發現這群聽眾對內容的了解比預期多，對實作的了解卻比想像少，因此真正有用的補充不是資訊，而是有人會坐下來設計重組 DNA 這件事。Bharat Sevashram Sangha（7 月 8 日，十年級）是一所供 Scheduled Tribe 學生就讀的住宿學校：原本準備好的十年級課程必須在課堂進行中從基礎詞彙重新搭建，團隊也直白寫下這個教訓：決定起點的是先前接觸過什麼，而不是年齡；而他們之所以沒注意到自己對年齡的假設，是因為在其他地方這個假設都成立。研究院開放日（7 月 10 日）直接把 FINS 本身當展品，包括那些沒成功的部分，以短場次的方式對九至十二年級的混合群體講了四十到五十次；這場活動獲州立公共廣播機構 DD Bangla 報導，把專案帶到一般的孟加拉語閱聽眾面前。一場為期一週、與 Kendriya Vidyalaya 合辦、約 70 名來自印度東北部學生參加的院內夏令營，包含實驗室導覽、專案的建模面向，以及一場原創的合成生物學犯罪現場調查。與 Ek Pehal 的長期合作則有週六的校內課程與週日的社區走訪，對象是 IISER Kolkata 周邊聚落的孩子；團隊為此撰寫了 41 份針對八至十二年級的免費教材（英文、印地語與孟加拉語），另有 36 份給更小孩子的識字、算術與科學教材。一場關於出國攻讀碩博士的免費線上講座吸引 151 人報名，講者包括 Dr Deepak Kumar Malik（DAAD IndiAlumni 會長）與 Emerging Scholars Council。教具全以紙板、紙張與回收物製作，團隊指出這是一項非預期但值得保留的結果：製作成本為零的材料，正是一所沒有科學預算的學校能原樣重做的材料。
good.ihp: Around thirty engagements written to an explicit template that starts with 'Need: the assumption we were carrying and the gap we hoped to fill'. The project originates outside the lab, on the deck of the Fishery Survey of India vessel M.F.V. Matsya Darshini off Visakhapatnam, where the team lead logged a haul of twenty-six fish before the team existed; months later they returned to the same coast to test the observation. The page's integrity is its best feature: three engagements are documented as having declined to give the finding the team went in for. Mr Mohadep Dutta, who has fished the Ganga since he was seven, could not comment on a shift in sex ratio because it is not visible to him, and the team records that as evidence the effect is invisible without instrumentation rather than resolving the disagreement in their favour. The closed loops are structural. Wastewater practitioner S.K. Ghosh (Director, Effluents and Water Treatments Engineer) established that Indian plants disinfect with sodium hypochlorite rather than UV on cost grounds, which forced the kill-switch trigger to be rebuilt around RclR, an AraC-family activator responding specifically to hypochlorous acid and one of only three HOCl-sensing regulators known in E. coli K-12, chosen partly because it activates rather than de-represses so the lysis cassette is off by default; the original UV/LexA-SOS switch was retained and published as a part for the global market rather than discarded. A SAV Water WWTP engagement supplied the operating envelope (aerobic, 8-16 hours aeration). An oceanographer corrected their dispersal modelling, which had assumed static water and annual averages, and established that any dispersal work must rest on seasonal INCOIS current and sea surface temperature data for the Bay of Bengal. A fish ecologist supplied three zebrafish endpoints (egg-laying, mating patterns, growth) and a two-layer safety framework that now structures the toxicity plan, plus the caution that wild-caught fish do not reproduce reliably in confinement, which is why the team nowhere extrapolates from model organisms to wild populations. An account of broken enforcement changed who the Human Practices work addresses, so community and regulatory engagement now run as two parallel levers of equal weight rather than outreach built around regulation. A hospital-effluent intervention branch was closed rather than kept as an alternative. Literature was treated as the first stakeholder, and stakeholders handed over documents (Central Pollution Control Board sector-specific effluent discharge standards, the Department of Fisheries Handbook on Fisheries Statistics) that are cited as such. Prior iGEM teams were studied as precedent: JU Krakow 2024 for an environmental biosensor in a regulatory context where the compound was not monitored, and Sao Carlos 2019 for documenting a regulatory framework that did not fit the work rather than forcing the work into it.
good.ihp_zh: 約三十場交流活動都依一套明確的模板撰寫，開頭是「需求：我們當時抱持的假設，以及我們希望填補的落差」。專案的起點不在實驗室，而是在 Visakhapatnam 外海、印度漁業調查署船隻 M.F.V. Matsya Darshini 的甲板上；當時團隊還不存在，隊長就記下了一網二十六條魚的漁獲，數個月後他們回到同一片海岸去檢驗這項觀察。這個頁面最好的地方是它的誠實：有三場交流被記錄為並未給出團隊原本想要的發現。自七歲起就在恆河捕魚的 Mr Mohadep Dutta 無法就性別比的變化發表意見，因為那對他而言是看不見的；團隊把這一點記錄為「沒有儀器就看不到這個效應」的證據，而不是把分歧解釋成對自己有利。閉環則是結構性的。污水處理從業者 S.K. Ghosh（Effluents and Water Treatments Engineer 總監）確立印度的處理廠出於成本考量是以次氯酸鈉而非 UV 消毒，這迫使自殺開關的觸發機制改以 RclR 重建；RclR 是 AraC 家族的活化子，專一回應次氯酸，也是 E. coli K-12 中目前已知僅有的三個 HOCl 感測調控因子之一，選它的部分理由是它採活化而非去抑制，因此裂解表現匣預設為關閉；原本的 UV/LexA-SOS 開關則被保留，並作為零件發表供全球使用，而不是直接丟棄。一場與 SAV Water 污水處理廠的交流提供了操作條件範圍（好氧、曝氣 8 至 16 小時）。一位海洋學家糾正了他們原先假設靜止水體與年平均值的擴散建模，並確立任何擴散工作都必須建立在 INCOIS 關於孟加拉灣的季節性洋流與海表溫度資料上。一位魚類生態學家提供了三項斑馬魚終點指標（產卵、交配模式、生長）與一套兩層的安全框架，如今成為毒性計畫的骨架；他並提醒野外捕獲的魚在圈養下無法穩定繁殖，這正是團隊在任何地方都不從模式生物外推到野生族群的原因。一段關於執法失靈的陳述改變了人類實踐工作所訴求的對象，因此社區參與與法規參與現在是兩條權重相等的平行槓桿，而不是圍繞法規安排的推廣。一條針對醫院廢水的介入支線被關閉，而不是留作備案。文獻被當成第一位利害關係人，而利害關係人交付的文件（中央污染控制委員會的分業別放流水標準、漁業部的 Handbook on Fisheries Statistics）也以此身分被引用。過往 iGEM 團隊被當作前例研究：JU Krakow 2024 作為在該化合物未被監測的法規情境下做環境生物感測器的案例，Sao Carlos 2019 則示範了如何記錄一套並不貼合自身工作的法規架構，而不是硬把工作塞進去。
good.realWorld: Deployment is specified down to plant siting and footprint: a sealed tank with cells in a PVA-alginate matrix placed after secondary treatment and before chlorination, so the influent is already low in solids and organics and the plant's own chlorination stage serves as containment. The matrix composition window is argued from transport, not convenience, with alginate alone rejected because ionic Ca2+ crosslinks are reversible and destabilised by phosphate and citrate, and the blend bounded below roughly 1.5% alginate (skin forms too slowly to prevent agglomeration during extrusion) and above roughly 12% PVA (network tightens enough to impede transport). Chassis choice is reasoned against Pseudomonas putida KT2440, the standard bioremediation chassis. Sensitivity is framed as the principal engineering constraint from the outset, citing published EdcR EC50 of 3.32 uM for E1 and 1.38 uM for E2 against typical environmental loads, and the team builds the circuit on a low-copy p15A origin in pTU2-A to trade absolute expression for reduced metabolic burden. The target was set by Indian conditions, where estrone dominates the pollutant profile and is reported at ug/L in Indian WWTP influent, and the economic case is made against granular activated carbon, ozonation and advanced oxidation, which work but are largely absent from Indian plants on capital cost, energy demand and retrofit grounds. They cite EU Directive 2024/3019 on quaternary treatment for micropollutants at plants above 150,000 p.e., phased to 2045, as the regulatory precedent, and are explicit that FINS targets a compound no Indian monitoring framework measures. The claim at the end is deliberately narrow, and the modelling's own verdict, that the LOD sits over three orders of magnitude above environmental concentrations, is published rather than buried. Deliverables left behind include a Biosafety and Bioethics Handbook as a standalone educational product covering pre-synthesis part screening, contained-versus-released design decisions and stakeholder integration, and the genetic engineering and CRISPR slide deck released for other teams.
good.realWorld_zh: 部署方式細到處理廠的位置與佔地：一座密閉槽體，細胞固定在 PVA-海藻酸鹽基質中，設在二級處理之後、加氯之前，因此進流水的固體與有機物已經偏低，而處理廠自身的加氯步驟即可作為生物圍阻。基質組成的範圍是以傳輸特性而非方便性來論證：單用海藻酸鹽被否決，因為離子性 Ca2+ 交聯可逆，且會被磷酸鹽與檸檬酸鹽破壞穩定；混合比例的下界約為 1.5% 海藻酸鹽（低於此，表層形成太慢，無法在擠出過程中防止結塊），上界約為 12% PVA（高於此，網絡緊密到會阻礙傳輸）。宿主選擇是對著生物修復的標準底盤 Pseudomonas putida KT2440 來論證的。靈敏度從一開始就被定位為主要的工程限制，團隊引用已發表的 EdcR EC50（對 E1 為 3.32 uM、對 E2 為 1.38 uM）對比典型的環境負荷，並把迴路建在 pTU2-A 中的低拷貝數 p15A 複製起點上，以絕對表現量換取較低的代謝負擔。標的物由印度的條件決定：雌酮主導當地的污染物組成，且在印度污水處理廠進流水中被報告為 ug/L 等級；經濟論證則是對照粒狀活性碳、臭氧處理與高級氧化，這些方法有效，但因建置成本、能耗與改裝困難，在印度的處理廠中幾乎不存在。他們引用歐盟 Directive 2024/3019 關於 150,000 人口當量以上處理廠須對微量污染物採行四級處理、分階段實施至 2045 年的規定作為法規先例，並明說 FINS 針對的是一個印度監測架構完全不量測的化合物。最後的主張刻意收得很窄，而建模自身的判決，也就是 LOD 比環境濃度高出三個數量級以上，是被公布而不是被埋起來。留下的交付成果包括一本獨立的教育產品《Biosafety and Bioethics Handbook》，涵蓋合成前的零件篩查、封閉式與釋放式設計的取捨，以及利害關係人整合；另有一份供其他團隊使用、已釋出的基因工程與 CRISPR 簡報。
partners: CIFRI Barrackpore (Dr S.K. Nag, Dr Kavita Kumari)
Bharat Sevashram Sangha Residential School for ST students

gemsTakeaway: Teach students to compute the detection limit their design can actually reach, then publish it even when it damns the project: IISER-Kolkata derived an LOD of 54.5 ng/mL from Fisher information and a Cramer-Rao bound, showed by sweeping every gain parameter x1000 that amplification moves signal and noise together, and then stated plainly that environmental levels sit three orders of magnitude lower. For a centre with school-age students, their second transferable practice costs nothing: build every teaching prop from cardboard, paper and reused items, because a resource that costs nothing to make is one a school with no budget can rebuild exactly as you ran it.
gemsTakeaway_zh: 教學生算出自己的設計實際能達到的偵測極限，然後即使這個數字會判自己的專案死刑也照樣公布：IISER-Kolkata 由 Fisher 資訊量與 Cramer-Rao 下界推導出 54.5 ng/mL 的 LOD，再以把每個增益參數都放大 1000 倍的掃描顯示放大會讓訊號與雜訊一起上升，然後直白說出環境中的濃度比這低三個數量級。對一個有中小學生參與的單位來說，他們第二項可移轉的做法不花一毛錢：所有教具都以紙板、紙張與回收物製作，因為製作成本為零的教材，正是一所沒有預算的學校能照你的做法原樣重做的教材。
